name: Royal Red
source:
A century ago, red magic destroyed the world. Now, you wield that same power – and you'll need help to survive.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
一百年前，赤红魔法毁灭了世界。如今，你的手中正掌握着同样的力量——而你需要他人的帮助才能活下去。

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
